latencyDiagnostics.scope: Secondary observations only; original action spans and 100/300ms thresholds remain unchanged. No keys, values, raw URLs or response content. Resource timing is browser network timing, not backend function timing. Callback self-time is partial instrumentation accounting; total overhead and physical paint remain unknown.

browserTimingLedger.scope: Incrementally drained passive Event Timing; unsupported documents stay explicit. Counts and sequence checks do not establish physical input latency.

limitations: Structural DOM/native-enabled predicate only; rendered selection is not server provenance or permission authority.
First observed witness may be late; no actual first-ready, physical paint, frontend cause, overhead subtraction or acceptance claim.
Fixed four-project context/authority cohort only. Unobservable transitions require explicit harness invalidation.
Sampling and transport add overhead; original full action metrics and thresholds remain unchanged.
